statement: Huawei's chairman asserts Ascend's share of China's AI chip market should be bigger than NVIDIA's, but the company provided no data to support the estimate.
why: If Ascend really has overtaken merchant GPUs in China, the China revenue line is structurally smaller than headline demand suggests; the claim is unverified, so it can only be treated as a possibility to watch.

impact.mechanism: A larger domestic share would mean Chinese AI compute spend routes to Ascend rather than to merchant GPUs, shrinking the addressable China segment.

evidence.excerpt: Huawei did not provide data to support the estimate

reasoning: The only support is an executive's stated belief; the article explicitly records that no supporting data was supplied and no percentage was given, so no measured share can be taken from this document.

confidence.basis: Unsupported executive assertion in secondary reporting, flagged by the article itself as lacking data.
